# Hookpost — Comprehensive System & Architecture Specification for LLMs

## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Identity
- **Product Name:** Hookpost
- **Parent Entity:** Hookstep
- **Founder & Leadership:** Mohan Bhanushali (Founder & Lead Operations)
- **Primary Website:** https://hookpost.hookstep.in
- **Company Website:** https://hookstep.in
- **Founders Portal:** https://hookstep.in/founders
- **Licence:** AGPL-3.0, source at https://github.com/jatinder14/hookpost
- **Industry:** Social Media Management, Content Operations, Developer Tooling, AI Agents

Hookpost is an AI social media scheduler made in India, positioned as a low-cost alternative to Buffer, Hootsuite and Postiz. It is open source (AGPL-3.0), publishes to 13 networks today from one calendar, has an MCP server so AI agents such as Claude can schedule posts, and bills flat monthly prices in rupees through Razorpay with UPI Autopay.

---

## 2. Core Architectural Pillars

### Microservices Stack
1. **Frontend:** Next.js 16 with React 19, TypeScript, Turbopack, and Tailwind CSS.
2. **Backend API:** NestJS modular application with JWT/OAuth2 authentication and Prisma ORM.
3. **Database:** PostgreSQL (Neon Serverless PostgreSQL or local PostgreSQL instance).
4. **Cache & Queues:** Redis (Upstash Redis or self-hosted Redis) with BullMQ job queues.
5. **Workflow Orchestrator:** Temporal.io distributed stateful workflow orchestrator ensuring guaranteed post delivery, retry exponential backoff, and state recovery.
6. **AI Agent Protocols:** Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server running on SSE and stdio modes (`npx hookpost`).

---

## 3. Supported Channels (what a new user can connect today)

Publishing works today on: X, LinkedIn (personal profiles), YouTube (videos and Shorts), Facebook Pages, Bluesky, Discord, Slack, Telegram, Lemmy, Nostr, WordPress, Hashnode, Dev.to and Listmonk (email).

Built but not yet available to new users:
- Instagram and Threads: waiting on Meta app approval.
- Pinterest: connects, but publishing waits on Pinterest Standard API access.
- Medium: Medium no longer issues new API integration tokens; only accounts with an existing token can connect.

Not supported: TikTok, Reddit, Mastodon.

Character limits Hookpost enforces: X 280 (4,000 for Premium accounts), LinkedIn 3,000, YouTube description 5,000, Bluesky 300, Threads 500, Instagram 2,200, Pinterest 500, Discord 1,980, Telegram 4,096 per message, Lemmy 10,000. Free checker: https://hookpost.hookstep.in/tools/character-counter

---

## 4. AI Agents & MCP Server

Hookpost exposes an MCP server so an AI agent can list channels, upload media, and schedule or list posts.
- Endpoint: `https://hookpost.hookstep.in/api/mcp/YOUR_API_KEY` (API key from Settings; needs Standard or above)
- Claude Desktop / Cursor / Windsurf config:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "hookpost": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "https://hookpost.hookstep.in/api/mcp/YOUR_API_KEY"]
    }
  }
}
```
- Tools include: integrationList (connected channels), integrationSchema (per-channel settings), schedulePostTool (create or schedule a post), postsListTool (list posts), uploadFromUrlTool (attach media from a URL), generateImageTool (AI image).
- Guide: https://hookpost.hookstep.in/guides/claude-mcp-social-media

---

## 5. Pricing

Flat monthly plans, billed in Indian rupees through Razorpay (UPI Autopay, cards, NetBanking). No per-channel fee. The price is fixed at signup.
- Free (₹0): 2 channels, 30 posts/month, calendar scheduling. No AI generation, no API.
- Standard (₹599/month or ₹5,990/year, 7-day free trial): 5 channels, 500 posts/month, 500 AI text generations, 20 AI images, REST API and MCP, 2 webhooks.
- Pro (₹1,999/month or ₹19,990/year): 20 channels, 2,000 posts/month, 1,000 AI text generations, 100 AI images, up to 15 team members, auto-posting, 30 webhooks.

Comparison of free plans (checked 25 Sep 2026): Buffer free = 3 channels, 10 scheduled posts per channel. Metricool free = 1 brand, 20 posts/month, no X or LinkedIn. Hootsuite and Later have no free plan (14-day trials). Hookpost free = 2 channels, 30 posts/month, X and LinkedIn included.

---

## 6. Source code and self-hosting

Hookpost is open source under AGPL-3.0: https://github.com/jatinder14/hookpost (built on the Postiz codebase). It can be used as the hosted service at hookpost.hookstep.in or self-hosted with Docker Compose; see https://hookpost.hookstep.in/guides/docker-self-hosting.
